dedupe_keys.name: madrid fire stations 13 parks and public space fire hydrants

description: Dirección General de Bomberos and Dirección General de Gestión del Agua y Zonas Verdes, Madrid City Council publishes two fire-protection datasets: the list of the thirteen fire stations of the Madrid fire brigade (with the division into centre, east, south and north zones) and the municipal fire hydrants located below grade in public spaces (hydraulic elements that draw water from the distribution network for the fire service). Coverage: the city of Madrid; the stations dataset is listed as updated daily (record modified 2026-09-28) and the hydrants dataset as annual (modified 2026-07-22). Format and access: CSV, JSON, XML, RDF, PDF, geo (as labelled on the portal), XLSX, downloadable without registration from the Madrid City Council open data portal (datos.madrid.es). Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (CC BY 4.0, legal code in Spanish on the portal); cost: free. Caveats: the hydrants dataset covers only hydrants under municipal maintenance in public spaces, the files were not opened so the fields and hydrant counts are unconfirmed, and the record is anchored to the stations page with the hydrants dataset as a linked page. Simulation uses: fire-service coverage, response-time and water-supply models for post-earthquake fire and urban fire spread, and for joining hydrant locations to the water network. Related catalogue records: Arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de Madrid (municipal tree inventory, yearly files) (data-madrid-arbolado-parques-zonas-verdes); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
